title: Effect of Fiscal Decentralization Financial Performance Against Local And Regional Gross Domestic Product (GDP) NTB
central_claims: Fiscal decentralization positively predicts regional financial performance in the NTB sample.
Neither the direct fiscal-decentralization nor financial-performance paths to GRDP are statistically significant; financial performance does not mediate the effect.

source_manifest.title: Declining financial performance of local governments in Indonesia: An empirical study during Covid-19
source_manifest.finding: Cites Amin 2020 only for general regional-resource management rationale. Methods use independently established financial ratios; does not reproduce original PLS/GRDP paths.

source_manifest.title: The Effect of Fiscal Decentralization, and Financial Performance on Economic Growth of Mataram City, Indonesia
source_manifest.finding: Mataram 2010–2022 ECM analysis reports positive short-run decentralization and positive financial-efficiency/effectiveness growth associations, but long-run decentralization nonsignificant. Different measures/design and no Amin 2020 citation; does not directly refute or reproduce original.

source_manifest.title: The Effect of Fiscal Decentralization on Financial Performance and Its Implications on Village Financial Management Accountability
source_manifest.finding: Author-led follow-up search found a village-level study by Amin M., Akram and Irwan. It tests revenues, transfers and accountability in20 developed Central Lombok villages, not the NTB district GRDP mediation result. No target DOI or title in references; independent identity not assumed from the common name.

search_gaps: No direct independent reproduction, explicit authoritative reassessment or operational policy use established.
Related regional findings differ, but changing geography, variables and econometric method prevents treating them as a decisive refutation.
General fiscal-decentralization research is not specific uptake; no inference from citation counts.
Additional author/GRDP searches locate related village-accountability and regional-ratio work, but no verified extension of this particular district-level GRDP result.
research.summary: Full original read. One later citation is contextual only; nearby Mataram research finds partly different effects under another model. The specific NTB PLS results have unresolved validation, utility and durability; no comparative-method advantage applies.
